allOf.description: Defines an action that can be taken on a product in the inventory as part of a product order. It is expected that this entity will be attached to product catalog items such as specifications and offerings. This DCS schema is a subset of the standard AllowedProductAction schema, that can be extended for specific contexts. This must be done reusing existing attributes in the standard AllowedProductAction schema or adding specific attributes.

id.description: Unique identifier of the AllowedProductAction within the array.

action.description: The name of the action. Values must be taken from this list (or extended it adding more values) : add, modify, delete.

DcsCategoryRef.description: Reference to a category in the catalog. This DCS schema is a subset of the standard CategoryRef schema, that can be extended for specific contexts. This must be done reusing existing attributes in the standard CategoryRef schema or adding specific attributes.

allOf.description: Is based on both the basic cost to develop and produce products and the enterprises policy on revenue targets. This price may be further revised through discounting (a Product Offering Price that reflects an alteration). This DCS schema is a subset of the standard ProductOfferingPrice schema, that can be extended for specific contexts. This must be done reusing existing attributes in the standard ProductOfferingPrice schema or adding specific attributes.

id.description: Unique identifier of the ProductOfferingPrice within the array.

lastUpdate.description: the last update time of this ProductOfferingPrice

lifecycleStatus.description: Used to indicate the current lifecycle status. Values must be taken from this list (or extended it adding more values for a specific context) : inStudy, inDesign, inTest, active, launched, retired, obsolete, rejected.

priceType.description: Used to indicate the current price type. Values must be taken from this list (or extended it adding more values for a specific context) : usage, oneTime, recurring, discountFee, discountPercentage, taxFee, taxPercentage, taxRule, replacementUsage, remplacementOneTime, replacementRecurring.

allOf.description: Specification of Terms or Conditions of the ProductOffering. This DCS schema is a subset of the standard ProductOfferingTermOrCondition schema, that can be extended for specific contexts. This must be done reusing existing attributes in the standard ProductOfferingTermOrCondition schema or adding specific attributes.

id.description: Locally unique identifier of the productOfferingTermOrConditionSpecification within its product offering

description.description: A narrative that explains in detail what the productOfferingTermOrConditionSpecification is
